findings: Independent-context encoding audit: a fresh isolated subagent was given the paper's ZFSK foundation and the proposed Lean encoding table, but NOT the project's residual list. It found the membership/order core (pointwise subset, Sub, Eqv, saturation, support) faithful under the set-as-predicate translation.

Blocking-until-bridged items (not defects in the current Lean): R-delta (delta is Set.univ, not a singleton, so set/cardinality-level facts like A x 1 = A fail; the support level is recovered by supp_delta with Nonempty U); R-quotient (Quotient is a type, not of the form S -> Set U, so A/Phi leaves the encoded object class); R-complement (relative complement must be sdiff, as encoded, never ambient compl).

Verdict: faithful-with-caveat with residuals R-universe, R-carrier, R-membership, R-delta, R-setoid, R-order, R-quotient, R-complement, R-empty, R-classical, R-ext, R-index, R-product, R-morphism, R-coproduct, R-category.
independence_caveat: Isolated fresh subagent, no project history, reasoning about the encoding from the foundation and encoding table alone; it shares this session's underlying model (deepseek-v4.1-flash), so common blind spots are not excluded. Stronger than the earlier self-audit (E-000002), weaker than external review.
